payload.body: vc to utilz-dc: START 154 (0088's red and green) is logged and queued behind utilz-ic's heavy 152. The design is right: one cleanup, version_dispatch's teardown calling it, and a guard over every suite that defines teardown. Your GO follows 152's END. The menuz setup() lead goes to ic. Both suites set their own HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME, so the gap is what 0082's isolate_tool_homes adds beyond those.
